title: Intravitreal vs. subtenon triamcinolone acetonide for the treatment of diabetic cystoid macular edema

groups.description: One eye of each of 14 patients (type II diabetes on insulin, diffuse cystoid macular edema, phakic), assigned by a computer-generated random method to a single 4 mg intravitreal triamcinolone acetonide injection.
The fellow eye of the same 14 patients, given a single 40 mg posterior sub-Tenon triamcinolone acetonide injection one week after the intravitreal injection of the first eye.

series.baseline_label: Baseline visual acuity (logMAR), Table 1, IVT column
series.notes: mean ± SD (Methods: data presented as means ± SD; Wilcoxon signed-rank test used); per-visit n not reported

series.baseline_label: Baseline visual acuity (logMAR), Table 1, SBT column
series.notes: mean ± SD (Methods: data presented as means ± SD; Wilcoxon signed-rank test used); per-visit n not reported; months counted from this eye's own injection (one week after the fellow eye's injection)

exclusions.what: Table 2 central macular thickness and Table 3 intraocular pressure
exclusions.reason: Not visual acuity (thickness and pressure are not extracted here)

exclusions.what: Results and Abstract text acuity values
exclusions.reason: Text, not table cells (they agree with the cited Table 1 cells)

notes: Table 1 labels the values 'Visual Acuity' in logMAR; the Methods state that the best-corrected logMAR visual acuity was assessed with the ETDRS chart in all patients, which establishes best-corrected acuity and unit.
Paired-eye design: 28 eyes of 14 patients, one eye per arm; both arms are treated eyes (no untreated fellow eyes).
Role: two routes of the same corticosteroid are compared and neither arm is declared experimental, so both are role control.
All focal leaks had been treated by laser photocoagulation before the triamcinolone injection (prior_treatment previously_treated).
Systemic acetazolamide was given for two days before the intravitreal injection; topical netilmicin after both injections.
No retreatment within the 6 months is described (regimen single).
